output:
**A little update from Lotus Glow Nails 💅**

Dear friends, neighbors, my church family, and all my customers who have been coming to me for so many years,

Thank you so much for all your texts, calls, prayers, and food. Mrs. Dung even brought me pho this morning! My phone has been ringing nonstop, so I thought I would write one letter for everybody. Please feel free to share it in your group texts and emails.

On Sunday, November 8, around 2 a.m., a lady’s car came through the front window of my salon, Lotus Glow Nails, on Bellaire Blvd. Yes, through the window! Thank God nobody was inside. The driver is okay, the police came, and her insurance will pay for the damage.

The front glass is gone, one pedicure chair is smashed, and the floor looks like a rainbow threw up. My husband looked at everything and said, “Finally, the shop is modern art.” The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like she wanted a spa treatment. My daughter said she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston!

I did cry a little in the morning. After 11 years in this shop, seeing it like that was very hard. But I am okay now. God protected everybody, and that is the most important thing. Please laugh a little with me—don’t worry about me!

**For your nails this week:** Trang, Kim, and I will be working at my cousin Hoa’s salon, **Pearland Nail Bar**. Please **call or text my cell at 832-555-0147** to make an appointment or ask where to go.

**For reopening:** The city inspector needs to check the wall before I can open. My contractor says we should reopen at **Lotus Glow Nails on Monday, November 16**, once everything is inspected and approved.

And please don’t worry—**all customer gift cards are still good. Nobody will lose their money.**

Thank you for loving me and supporting my little salon all these years. We will clean up, fix everything, and be back soon—with a new window and, hopefully, no more drive-thru pedicures!

Love you all,  
**[Your Name]**  
**Lotus Glow Nails**
